description: This file defines the UserAgentMiddleware class, which constructs and injects user agent headers into HTTP requests within the AWS SDK for PHP. It handles various platform and configuration details to build a detailed user agent string used for metrics and debugging.

classes.name: UserAgentMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware responsible for building and injecting a detailed user agent string into AWS SDK PHP requests, including SDK version, environment details, and custom metrics.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Returns a closure that wraps a handler with the middleware, configured with specified arguments.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the middleware with the next handler and configuration arguments.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invoked to process a command and request, injecting the user agent header before passing control to the handler.

methods.name: requestWithUserAgentHeader
methods.description: Builds and injects the user agent string into the request headers.

methods.name: buildUserAgentValue
methods.description: Constructs an array of user agent components based on various system and configuration data.

methods.name: getUserAgentVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string for the user agent.

methods.name: getHhvmVersion
methods.description: Returns the HHVM version if available.

methods.name: getOsName
methods.description: Returns the operating system name and version.

methods.name: getEndpointDiscovery
methods.description: Returns a string indicating if endpoint discovery is enabled.

methods.name: appendEndpointMetric
methods.description: Appends endpoint override metric if applicable.

methods.name: appendAccountIdModeMetric
methods.description: Appends account ID mode metric based on args.

methods.name: appendRetryConfigMetric
methods.description: Appends retry mode metric based on configuration.
